mainText: Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! It is a warm, muggy 76 degrees with overcast skies tonight over Verona Area High School, feeling like a sticky 83. The moon is a beautiful Waxing Crescent, and you have a stellar chance to spot the ISS flying overhead starting at 11:54 PM for two minutes!
Whip those kitchens into shape, apartment dwellers! You can now easily compost your scraps by dropping them off at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue.
Get ready to jam out because Concerts in the Park is back at Century School Park this Thursday, July 16th! Pack your blankets and picnic baskets for some incredible free live music!
Let's talk about the local hustle. On Tuesday, July 7th, alert citizens blocked an attempted alcohol theft at a local convenience store, leading officers right to the teenage culprits an hour later.
Sweet tooth calling? Today's delicious flavor at Culver's is Chocolate Covered Strawberry! They are closed right now but open up at 10:00 AM, so get ready to run over for a scoop!
